tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Fetch one URL and return the page as markdown, plain text or raw HTML. Use it to read a page whose URL you have; use extract_data instead for specific fields as JSON, and search_web when you have no URL yet. JavaScript is rendered by default (5 credits); render_js false is a plain HTTP fetch (1 cred

tools.name: extract_data
tools.description: Fetch one URL and return JSON built from CSS or XPath selectors: named fields instead of a whole page. Use it when you know which elements hold the data (prices, titles, links, tables); read the page with fetch_page first if you do not. It costs what fetch_page costs. A rule that matches nothing ret

tools.name: search_web
tools.description: Search Google, Bing, Yahoo and Brave (one engine per call) and return one results page as JSON: organic_results (position, title, url, description, date), top_ads, bottom_ads, related_searches, questions and number_of_results. Use it to find pages when you have no URL; then read a result with fetch_
